about_the_game:
About the Demo

The Chronal Stasis Demo takes you to the past to fight a village of Vikings in one level of the game. You'll encounter 3 types of enemies, 4 time-bending abilities, and 1 boss fight as you fight your way through a level that takes place around the middle of the game. Whomever defeats the boss and walks to the portal, a mysterious woman awaits. 

About Chronal Stasis

Embark on a time-warped story as Henry to save his family and bring peace to this world. Harness the power of time, a plasma rifle, and modern mechanics in this thrilling 2.5D side-scrolling adventure. Confront adversaries who defy the natural order of history as you know it and uncover the truth behind their unexpected rise to power.

The fate of the past, present, and future rests in your hands.

Key Features

  • Traverse centuries of time across multiple levels accompanied by a soundtrack of music heard from that era.

  • Finely tuned controls and gameplay allow you to quickly and efficiently navigate and fight your way through the levels.

  • No ammo or reloading required! Armed with a prototype plasma rifle, blast through your enemies and never worry about reloading at the most inconvenient time.

  • Harness a myriad of time-bending abilities to defeat your foes! Dash through portals. Rapidly de-age enemies. Freeze the very fabric of time!

  • Face 21 enemies and vanquish 9 bosses from creepy cultists to ancient Vikings to deranged science experiments!

*  This game is still in early development and as a result the images seen are only of 1 level. More diverse game images will come throughout development. *

content_descriptors.notes: Contains general violence and blood spatter pertaining to shooting and killing enemies and bosses.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: Intel i7 6700k or similar
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or similar
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: Intel i7 - 10700k or similar
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 or similar
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: Travel to and blast your way through the past in this 2.5D time-traveling, platformer-esque game that combines classic run and gun elements with time-bending abilities. Join Henry as he fights to save his family and fix the timeline. Is it really that simple though?
